title: Add Environment Variable Validation
description: Validate required environment variables are present. Must check for PODIO_CLIENT_ID and PODIO_CLIENT_SECRET, return clear error if missing, validate format (non-empty strings), and provide error message that guides user to fix issue.
details: Sprint 2 - Podio Authentication. Prevents runtime errors from missing configuration.
testStrategy: Test with missing variables, empty variables, valid variables, verify error messages are helpful.
